svg.text: Dense, varied particles fall beneath source clouds. Coverage follows the supplied condition.
Overcast from edge to edge; rain below cloud base.
Open sky between clouds; rain below those clouds.
Cloud bank above all falling snow; no exposed moon.
No precipitation mark appears in cloud-free sky or above its source cloud. Text and selected time stay readable above the art.
A carried hour keeps the prior supplied scene and its source time; it does not create a new weather fact.
